title: NizTweaks: Tuff to Zinc and Copper
description: Mill Tuff for low chance of Copper and Zinc
body:
Ever played Skyblock with Create Mod and realized you're stuck in the Andesite Age

with not a zinc nugget in sight? 

LET'S UNLOCK THAT SOFTLOCK

NizTweaks has got you!

 

This is a simple datapack made to complement the Create: Skyblock Infinite Modpack,

but can be used in any create mod world

 

It simply adds a recipe to mill Tuff for a low chance of copper and zinc nuggets
